schedules.feature_grid: Every requested feature-grid slot within the prediction period and official session

outputs.quality: Independent sigmoid scores, one per trading-day window; not a probability distribution
outputs.channels: Opening-frozen slope (price/feature period), full width (price), level at opening (price)
outputs.exception: Decoded alternative channel and raw/adjusted/better-quality probabilities with separate validity
outputs.adjusted_exception_probability: Deployed decoder probability, identical to training HTML reports; already adjusted
